source_detail: Cravath transaction page plus URI proposed/pricing releases
calculation_or_source: Synthesis of counsel and company releases
what_it_says: The buyer-side channel is visible as an initial-purchaser private-offering channel.
what_it_does_not_say: The names of the initial purchasers and ultimate investors are not visible.
next_source: Offering memorandum, purchase agreement, transaction database, or registration-rights agreement

calculation_or_source: Cravath states it represented the initial purchasers in connection with the 1.1B high-yield senior notes offering
what_it_says: Initial purchasers existed and had counsel on the transaction.
what_it_does_not_say: The page does not name the initial purchaser firms.

calculation_or_source: Cravath describes the 1.1B high-yield senior notes offering
what_it_says: The counsel evidence maps to the same 1.100B USD note financing.
what_it_does_not_say: It does not split allocations by bank or investor.

what_it_says: The note offering close date is visible from counsel's deal page.
what_it_does_not_say: It does not prove acquisition close source-and-use by itself.
next_source: Closing source-and-use or acquisition funding schedule

calculation_or_source: Initial purchasers would offer to qualified institutional buyers under Rule 144A or outside the United States under Regulation S
what_it_says: The distribution channel is institutional/private rather than registered public distribution.
what_it_does_not_say: It does not name purchasers or ultimate holders.

calculation_or_source: Rule 144A path limited to persons reasonably believed to be qualified institutional buyers
what_it_says: The intended domestic buyer class was QIBs.
what_it_does_not_say: It does not identify which QIBs bought the notes.

calculation_or_source: Regulation S path for certain persons outside the United States
what_it_says: The offering included an offshore institutional distribution path.
what_it_does_not_say: It does not identify offshore investors or allocation.

calculation_or_source: Estimated net proceeds after initial purchasers' discounts, commissions, and estimated fees/expenses
what_it_says: URI disclosed that initial purchasers' discounts and commissions reduced gross proceeds alongside estimated fees and expenses.
what_it_does_not_say: It does not separately quantify the discounts and commissions.

calculation_or_source: 1.100B gross principal minus 1.090B estimated net proceeds
what_it_says: The visible gross-to-net gap is about 10M USD.
what_it_does_not_say: The gap combines initial purchasers' discounts, commissions, and estimated fees/expenses; it is not a pure fee amount.

calculation_or_source: Indenture provides note terms and trustee but not initial-purchaser names
what_it_says: Legal note terms do not solve buyer identity.
what_it_does_not_say: It does not contradict the existence of initial purchasers; it only leaves names unresolved.

calculation_or_source: Combines Cravath counsel evidence with URI private-offering mechanics
what_it_says: The Yak note financing has initial-purchaser channel evidence.
what_it_does_not_say: Do not promote this to named initial purchasers, investor allocation, spread/yield, exact ABL allocation, or Matting ROIC.
next_source: Offering memorandum, purchase agreement, bond database, holder data
